notes.title: General Game Update
notes.notes:
Based on user feedback, we have given the game a bit of an overhaul:



General changes

Increased clarity for when you get a Game Over via extra effects.

Adjusted some collision settings that will make it easier to get a bubble into a gap.

Added a notification for when bubbles are flying in and added a display to make it clearer as to why it's happening:

Each 5 bubbles you launch triggers a few bubbles to fly in.

Added a timer that will occasionally launch in an additional bubble.

Bubbles you connect outside of the boundary that would normally trigger a Game Over will now burst if there is 3 of the same color connected.

Minor adjustments to boost performance.

Two new powerups

Freeze - While active, stops the bubble grid from spinning when bubbles hit it.

Scope - Adds a screen/scope to your launcher to assist with aiming the next shot.



In general, this should make the game clearer and a bit easier. Thanks for playing!
